title: Seahawks-Broncos in Week 6 draws 16.26 million on Prime Video

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks-Broncos in Week 6 draws 16.26 million on Prime Video
sources.description: Although an unresolved question lingers regarding whether or not the numbers are inflated by anyone who visits Amazon Prime and gets an autoplay video of the game, the official, Nielsen-generated numbers for Prime Video's Thursday Night Football keep improving.
